title: toona ciliata subsp. nepalensis
intro: Toona ciliata subsp. nepalensis, commonly known as the Himalayan cedar, is a subspecies of the Toona ciliata tree native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Toona ciliata subsp. nepalensis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to exhibit potential in reducing oxidative stress, modulating immune responses, and exhibiting anticancer properties.
